name: dsh-skill-hub
description: DSH dynamic Cordis plugin: list every resolved skill in Settings, toggle each one on or off, and read the shared ~/.agents/skills repository live.

scripts.build: node tools/build-payload.mjs --json > payload/code.json && node tools/build-payload.mjs > payload/bundle.txt
